1. Impacted Products

  • VMware Cloud Foundation
  • VMware Aria Operations
  • VCF Operations HCX

2. Introduction

Apache HTTP Server mod_http2 heap corruption remote code execution vulnerability. Workarounds are available to remediate this vulnerability in affected Broadcom products.

3. Apache HTTP Server mod_http2 remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-119618)

Description:
Apache HTTP Server as used in VMware Cloud Foundation Operations, VMware Aria Operations, and VCF Operations HCX contains a remote code-execution vulnerability in mod_http2. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8.

Known Attack Vectors:
A malicious actor with network access to VMware Aria Operations or VCF Operations HCX may exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code.

Resolution:
To mitigate CVE-2026-119618 apply the workarounds listed in the 'Workarounds' column of the 'Response Matrix' found below.

Workarounds:
See the Response Matrix.
